QuestInfo.name: Quartermaster Harpoon
QuestInfo.0: #bEdea#k's got yet another mission for the champion of justice!
QuestInfo.1: Procuring supplies isn't exactly what you had in mind, but it'll do. Find Quartermaster #bHarpoon#k in #bHeliseum Reclamation HQ#k.
QuestInfo.2: Quartermaster Harpoon actually looks pretty busy. Maybe you should come back later.

0.0: The front line has stabilized thanks in no small part to you.\r\n
0.1: But our supply lines are a mess. We can't live on week-old pizza and cardboard steaks, you know.\r\n
0.2: Help Quartermaster #bHarpoon#k figure out how to get some supplies through.\r\n

yes.0: There are twin brothers in the middle of #rHeliseum Reclamation HQ#k. The one with purple hair is #bHarpoon#k.\r\n

no.0: Well, if you're too busy, then I guess it can't be helped.\r\n

1.0: Ah, you must be the famous Specter dispatcher!? It's an honor to meet you. And I've gotta say, we could really use your help here. But hang on. I've got to finish a bit of bookkeeping before I can chat.\r\n

0.msg: #b(Looks like your reputation precedes you yet again. If only they could come up with better nicknames...)#k\r\n

default.0: There are twin brothers in the middle of #rHeliseum Reclamation HQ#k. The one with purple hair is #bHarpoon#k.\r\n
